# Tax Documentation: Retrieve Tax Documentation Document by ID

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`GET /tax-documentation-data/document/{documentId}` · account-owner-scoped token

Returns a generated PDF document by its ID for an Account Owner

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `documentId` | The Taxbit UUID for the Tax Documentation document. |

**Response 200**: Tax document details

Same fields as the response of [Generate Tax Documentation Document](generate-tax-documentation-document-owner-token.md).

**Errors:** 400 Invalid Data · 401 Forbidden · 403 Wrong Account Owner · 404 Tax Documentation Document Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
